Cloud Data Engine (CDE) | Experienced Python Software Engineer | France | HYBRID

We’re hiring an experienced Python engineer to work on a platform for compliance monitoring and interoperable service catalogues.

You’d work on backend services, REST APIs, compliance pipelines, rule engines, JSON-LD/RDF, Verifiable Credentials, and regulatory-to-technical rule translation.

Stack: Python 3, FastAPI, async, RDF4J, Docker, GitLab CI/CD.

Looking for: 5+ years Python in production, strong API/data modelling/system design skills, fluent French, professional English.

Nice to have: RDF/SPARQL, Kubernetes, LLM pipelines.

Apply via Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4399261912/?refId=hjnUg4M...
